parsed.hypothesis_statement: In synthetic parametric price series, a larger deviation of synthetic_price from latent_equilibrium_value predicts a next-period change toward latent_equilibrium_value, with this mean-reversion relationship stronger when contemporaneous_volatility is lower.
parsed.hypothesis_rationale: A latent-equilibrium process supplies a restoring force when observed synthetic price departs from equilibrium; higher contemporaneous volatility introduces larger transient disturbances that can obscure or overwhelm that restoring force. This tests equilibrium-error mean reversion rather than threshold-driven trade-frequency sensitivity.
